Also "located in the administrative territorial entity". Let's craft.

First, define subject: "Kerala High Court". subject_type: "court". object_type accordingly.

6. (Kerala High Court, has power to issue, directions). object_type "legal instrument". Similarly for orders, writs. Could combine but need separate triplets for each.

But the text: "issue directions, orders and writs including the writs of habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari". So we can have triplets:

Also "ensuring the enforcement of the Fundamental Rights guaranteed by the Constitution to citizens or for other specified purposes." This is purpose. Could have triplet: (Kerala High Court, purpose, enforcement of Fundamental Rights). But maybe "has purpose" relation. We'll include.

Also "has original, appellate and revisional jurisdiction in civil as well as criminal matters". So we can have:

Also "power to answer references to it under some statutes". Triplet:

Also "superintendence and visitorial jurisdiction over all courts and tribunals of inferior jurisdiction covered under its territorial jurisdiction."

Or combine: (Kerala High Court, has superintendence and visitorial jurisdiction over, courts and tribunals of inferior jurisdiction). But better separate.
